description: Source code for a JSON document loader component, including class definitions for loading JSON files, parsing JSON content, extracting metadata and content based on pointers, and handling file input/output.

classes.name: Json_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: A class implementing INode to load and parse JSON files, supporting features like metadata extraction, content separation, and file handling.

classes.name: TextLoader
classes.description: A class extending BaseDocumentLoader to load text from file paths or blobs, parse it, and create Document objects.

classes.name: JSONLoader
classes.description: A class extending TextLoader to specifically parse JSON content, extract content and metadata based on pointers, and handle JSON arrays or objects.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Asynchronous method to initialize the loader, read files, parse JSON, split documents, and add metadata.

methods.name: removeValuesStartingWithSlash
methods.description: Utility function to remove object properties with string values starting with '/'.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the document content, reads files or blobs, and returns an array of Document objects.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses raw JSON string into Document objects, handling array or single object JSON.

methods.name: extractContent
methods.description: Extracts content strings from JSON based on pointers.

methods.name: extractMetadata
methods.description: Extracts metadata from JSON objects based on a mapping.

methods.name: formatObjectAsKeyValue
methods.description: Formats a JSON object into a readable key-value string.

methods.name: extractArrayStringsFromObject
methods.description: Recursively extracts strings from JSON objects based on pointers or all strings if specified.

methods.name: getTargetedEntries
methods.description: Retrieves targeted entries from JSON objects based on JSON pointers.
